records.title: Jerusalem and the Ark
records.posterAlt: David celebrates before the ark as its bearers enter Jerusalem. An imagined scene.
records.description: David takes a joyful step before the covered ark and its bearers. This illustrates the procession in 2 Samuel 6:12-15, not the capture of Jerusalem or the whole passage.
records.encoding: 1280x720 24fps H264 Main3.1, no Bframes, GOP24, faststart, zero-based AAC timeline
records.visualReview: Full-size two-second frame and 1fps sheet preserve adult David’s brown face, dense curls, short beard, strong build, linen and blue mantle. Bearers keep the covered ark on shoulder poles. Visible hands, feet, drums and poles remain coherent; no identity break observed. Jerusalem’s scale remains an imagined setting, not an exact reconstruction.
